name: @vawe/cli
description: Open-source HTML to video: deterministic motion graphics as code for developers and AI agents. One HTML page in, one video out. Renders frame-by-frame in Chrome, encodes with ffmpeg.
//puppeteer-note: Renders launch puppeteer-core with the Chrome pinned in .puppeteerrc.cjs; the first render fetches it into ~/.cache/puppeteer. Full puppeteer is a dev dependency for the scripts and for npx puppeteer browsers install chrome in a checkout; its postinstall downloads a Chrome, so CI jobs that open no browser set PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1.
//oxlint-note: Code-quality enforcement: complexity, function length, nesting depth. Rust, so a whole-repo sweep runs in under a second and a single-file check is instant. That speed is what lets it run on every file WRITE (harness/live/post-edit.mjs) rather than only at push, which is the difference between a rule that shapes code and a rule that scolds after the fact. A comment key must stay at the ROOT of this file: npm parses every key inside devDependencies as a package name, and a `//name` entry there breaks `npm install` outright.
